## ✨ New in 0.3.0

**Kirby's Dead Land comes to Windows.** The same launcher and the same Kirby, built from the same code as the Linux version, for the Windows version of Dead Cells on Steam.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **The Windows version is a test.** It has not been tried on a real Windows 11 PC yet. If you try it, please [tell us how it went](https://github.com/NahuelGenchi/kirbys-dead-land/issues/new), whether it works or not.

**On Linux:** Kirby's sounds now play through the same audio system as Dead Cells itself, so they no longer depend on an extra library on your PC. Everything else plays as in 0.2.1.
